Method of Attack: Abuse of cryptographic flaws in Netlogon AES-CFB8 algorithm to spoof successful login
Elevation of privileges to domain administrator
Spoofing authentication responses to allow any login attempt to succeed
Exploitation of fallback to unencrypted RPC communication for authentication
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC) over RPC fallback to non-secure communication
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploits released by researchers including Rich Warren of NCC Group
Authentication requests over non-secure RPC communication
Logs of authentication requests from non-Windows devices not using secure RPC
